title: Flight Disruption Rebooking Agent
reference: Canonical source: packages/core/test/fixtures/workflows/disruption-rebooking-agent.json. Use international products and suitable model tiers. Gate every consequential effect on every path after the final producer; live replies need guarded input and human escalation.
